source_provenance.r740_to_r759_and_run40_and43: Retained code uses the original path, bytes, SHA256 and Git blob for every listed source, including the Run43 shared curved field basis. The signed parameter declares all eighteen physical and numerical module identities.
source_provenance.r761_and_r763: Use the exact two Git blobs specified in complete_parent_sources. R763 consumes R761 for its independent tube family. All scientific inputs are resolved on the immutable actual execution trigger commit and have their complete identities verified there.
source_provenance.direct_arrays: Both branches start directly from closed analytic and numerical reference evaluators. The only continuation arrays are the two winning Run44 families generated and maintained by this single public worker.

physics.fixed_tensor: R757 initial closed metric at every one of the 9 charts, including both true nonflat caps; no target refitting or width/hold shrink under space/time refinement.
physics.algorithm: All positive phases in one natural-cubic coefficient solve, two full L-BFGS blocks with newly rescanned 3D ordered chord pairs, exact linear shape adjoint and JAX differentiated physical metric/principal curvatures/pair costs. Independent corrected whole-body validation and terminal mesh on both branches.

scientific_budget.protocol: Complete 5 original coarse starts, three released and two tube. Select the lowest finite stage score independently in each group. Run all three original 4, 8 and 16 interval refinements on each winner for 11 stages. Each stage jointly solves every positive phase coefficient with two complete L-BFGS-B blocks, scans fresh physical normal-chord pairs after each block and validates the original finite chart, rim, seam and normal overlap on the independent spatial and temporal grids. On the same worker export for each of the two final points the union of all final validation phases and seven original world-mesh phases.

live.interpretation: All direct metric, curvature, ordered chord, seam, diameter and body measurements are finite samples. The training pair list combines scanned neighbors and separated points. The terminal pair scan and mesh each return their own physical sample identities. The two altered endpoints require their own uniform isometry, reach and noncongruence certification.

normal_scientific_entry.checkpoints: Each stage returns that stage’s original small JSON, exact coefficient point identity and runner field inventory.

mathematics: Use one fixed R757 initial material metric and both complete moving cap-to-roll interfaces. Three translated/developed-end starts and two tube-reference starts have independent selections and full refinement chains. The ambient coordinates of the R759 paired reference and both descendants are already the physical world frame: the right held head stays fixed while the left head undergoes the original changing translation. Apply the shared three-vector rim value, first transverse derivative and second transverse derivative as common physical data on each cap and roll. Fit both end interiors and both cap interiors against the complete initial target with all three ambient displacement components. All direct metric, curvature, ordered chord, seam, diameter and body measurements are finite samples. The training pair list combines scanned neighbors and separated points. The terminal pair scan and mesh each return their own physical sample identities. The two altered endpoints require their own uniform isometry, reach and noncongruence certification.
